resume: Free offers at 15 and 16, €50 at 17, €150 at 18, with an advantage in Mayotte: no €50 cap on online purchases. The documents to prepare for registration.
aQuoiCaSert: The pass Culture (France's culture pass for young people) makes culture easier for young people to access: books, cinema tickets, concerts, shows, lessons, musical instruments. It has an individual part, used by the young person in the app, and a collective part, used by teachers for class outings. Mayotte is one of the territories where it is available.
quiEstConcerne: Young people aged 15 to 18 living in mainland France or overseas, including Mayotte.
Young foreign nationals who have lived in France for at least 1 year.
aSavoir: Young people registered since March 1, 2025: free offers at 15 and 16, €50 at 17, €150 at 18.
The money can be used until the day before the young person turns 21.
Purchases of online offers (music, video, games, digital press...) are now capped at €50, except for young people living in Mayotte.

Registration: ID and proof of address in the young person's name. If they live with someone else, you also need that person's proof of address, a letter confirming they house the young person (attestation d'hébergement) and that person's ID.

documents.detail: Copy sent through the app. No ID? See the guide entry "Getting my child's ID card or passport".
